Gary Neville slaps himself in the FACE in bizarre on-air moment after Man United's humiliation at Anfield - weeks after claiming his old club are 'in a better place' than Liverpool

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 04:43 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.
  • Gary Neville showcased the dramatic decline of Manchester United this season as he bizarrely slapped himself in the face on Sky Sports after his former side's 4-0, 10-man, defeat to Liverpool at Anfield.
  • Neville's dramatic example of Man United's lack of hunger and sharpness came in stark contrast to his pre-season proclamations for the side, when he informed his co-pundit Jamie Carragher that he believed that then-manager Michael Carrick's starting XI was stronger than Liverpool's after a summer recruitment drive.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 04:43 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.

Gary Neville showcased the dramatic decline of Manchester United this season as he bizarrely slapped himself in the face on Sky Sports after his former side's 4-0, 10-man, defeat to Liverpool at Anfield.

Neville's dramatic example of Man United's lack of hunger and sharpness came in stark contrast to his pre-season proclamations for the side, when he informed his co-pundit Jamie Carragher that he believed that then-manager Michael Carrick's starting XI was stronger than Liverpool's after a summer recruitment drive.

Instead, Man United saw their numbers reduced inside the opening stages of the game after a reckless challenge by Leny Yoro, and 2-0 down after 13 minutes, with the club legend resorting to drastic methods to convey the side's weaknesses.

Of his old club's defenders, he said: 'I never see any of them on their toes, alert, looking like they've got something fixed in here', before pointing to his head.

In a recent development, 'I never see any of them look like that,' he added. 'They look like that -'.

Neville then stared into the middle distance for a few moments to share the blankness he sees on the faces of the back line, before spitting: 'Wake up!'.

Gary Neville took to slapping himself to convey the lack of focus he sees in Man United's stars.

The club legend had previously tipped his old side to have a stronger XI than Liverpool's.

But when the two teams met at Anfield, Man United were left woefully exposed after going down to 10 men.

The Overlap broadcaster then slapped his own face a number of times repeating 'wake up!' before adding: 'You play for Man United'.

The gesture left Carragher in stitches, with the Anfield icon collapsing onto the sofa in hysterics - although less impressed with Roy Keane, who displayed his usual sangfroid.

So tickled by the moment was the former Liverpool star that he later changed his profile picture on social media site X to a still image of Neville's hand catching his face.

Neville had more sharp criticism for Man United's defensive selection assessing the inclusion of Matthijs de Ligt in the starting line-up.

The Dutch defender has been out of Premier League action for 51 weeks after suffering a back injury, but was named by Mauricio Pochettino in his first-ever XI.

In a recent development, 'I have a lot of sympathy for him,' Neville admitted. 'It's like playing football after having six pints. It's a strange feeling.

'I have a lot of sympathy for him, it's alarming to watch.'.

Less sympathy for Man United's players came from Keane, who attacked the team - and Neville and Carragher - after the heavy defeat at Anfield confirmed the club's worst start in over 53 years.

The firebrand midfielder was on his usual caustic form as he assessed the damage, hitting out at those who might have accepted the score line, having feared a greater deficit.

In a recent development, 'If I hear that one more time from the lads in the commentary that 4-0 is not too bad when you're down to 10 men - has a team ever got a result with 10 men before?' Keane remarked immediately after the final whistle. 'It can be done.

Recent findings suggest that 'I thought United were desperate. I thought they were so bad and everyone and Nev, who played for Man United saying 4-0 ain't bad.'.

Sources indicate that '(The red card) doesn't help but you're telling me they couldn't have done better? They lost 4-0 with 10 men, that's not too bad? Has a team ever got a result with 10 men? It can be done. At least show a bit more fight, a bit more quality - I can't believe what I'm hearing from people.

Recent findings suggest that 'You played for the club, saying 4-0 isn't too bad. Wow. Fans are applauding. Applauding what? Performing rubbish. Liverpool were excellent, but how easy did United make it for them? I can't believe what I'm watching sometimes.

'This team two years ago finished 15th. The last year or two, we're talking. We're blaming the board, blaming ownership, blaming managers.

'When do the players take responsibility for some decision-making? Liverpool probably should have scored eight, probably eight or nine, unbelievable chances they had. And everyone's coming off the pitch saying 4 is not too bad? I feel like swearing.'.

The difference between the two teams felt a far cry from Neville's late-summer prediction, when he told Carragher that he had greater hopes for Carrick and Man United over incoming manager Andoni Iraola at Liverpool.

'I think Manchester United are at the moment in a better place than Liverpool,' Neville mentioned in August. 'Would you agree?'.

Carragher said that he did not, and will have been confident in his assessment on Sunday night.

Chiariello: “Migliore in campo Allegri, tre spanne sopra tutti”

📅 24 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (576 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Iamnaples

💡 Key Takeaways
  • According to recent reports, umberto Chiariello, giornalista, ha commentato a Canale 21 il pari del Napoli con il Manchester City in Champions League: “Migliore in campo Allegri, tre spanne sopra tutti.
  • Industry observers note that I Am Naples Testata Giornalistica - aut.

According to recent reports, umberto Chiariello, giornalista, ha commentato a Canale 21 il pari del Napoli con il Manchester City in Champions League: “Migliore in campo Allegri, tre spanne sopra tutti. Perché ci ha sorpreso tutti, con uno schieramento che nessuno aveva immaginato, prima mettendo in campo Lang, che era dato in panchina, ma soprattutto spostando Spinazzola a destra e giocando con il 4-3-3, con De Bruyne mezzala, che è il suo ruolo, numero 8, sacrificando Anguissa e facendolo entrare nel momento opportuno, quando la pressione era insostenibile e De Bruyne non ne aveva proprio più. Stasera due non mi hanno soddisfatto, De Bruyne e Milinkovic-Savic Perché De Bruyne ha avuto due palle al 57° e al 67°, me le sono appuntate, dove è solo a palla, Hojlund gli detta la profondità, uno come lui lo deve mandare in porta alla squadra, non per fare il lavoro di sacrificio. A me stasera De Bruyne non è del tutto soddisfatto perché quello che ci doveva dare, la qualità, non ce l’ha data. Si è sacrificato tanto, ma non ci serve questo da De Bruyne. Milinkovic sul primo gol va giù e deve rimanere in piedi, quella palla se rimane in piedi la prende, ma sul secondo si schiaccia proprio sul palo. Lui sbaglia la traslazione, si schiaccia sul palo, non può stare lì, deve lasciare un po’ di palo e coprire la porta. Il tiratore deve trovare lo specchio coperto, lui sbaglia la bisettrice, totalmente la traslazione, va sul palo e non è la prima volta che noto questo suo atteggiamento. Quel gol ce l’ha sulla coscienza. Ed è un peccato perché avevo appena finito di elogiarlo per la partita precedente. Ha mostrato personalità in uscita, qualche parata brutta ma efficace, ce n’è stata una nel primo tempo che mi ha fatto tremare, che l’ha presa in maniera raffazzonata, però aveva retto. Ma alla fine io penso che sia successo esattamente come 15 anni fa. L’ottimo De Sanctis, che a Napoli fece molto bene, in quella partita purtroppo non fu impeccabile e il Napoli, che meritava di vincerla con Mazzarri, la pareggiò 2-2. La stessa cosa capita 15 anni dopo, ancora il portiere non impeccabile. Gilmour è stato sicuramente tra i migliori in campo. Io premio Politano per il sacrificio e per la palla che dà a Spinazzola sulla destra, che è favolosa, ma Gilmour sicuramente ha fatto una grande partita, la migliore. Vorrei citare un giocatore nel suo ruolo, finalmente, centrale a due di difesa: Beukema ha dimostrato che non è un bidone e se Beukema prende fiducia, almeno con questo investimento possiamo pensare che torni qualcosa. Così come Lang forse è l’esterno che stavamo cercando e che, dandogli fiducia, ce l’abbiamo in casa”.

José Boto, Dirigente Sportivo del Flamengo ma con un passato anche allo Shakhtar e al Benfica, ha raccontato una storia su Gustavo Varela:.

"Con Varela ho una storia piuttosto curiosa, perché Gustavo Varela è il figlio di Fernando Varela, un difensore centrale che è stato un mio giocatore ai tempi del PAOK. Quando sono arrivato al PAOK, Fernando era addirittura uno dei capitani della squadra. In quel periodo aveva trovato poco spazio e alla fine ha deciso di tornare in Portogallo per concludere lì la propria carriera. E ha portato con sé anche suo figlio.

Questo per dire che, quando ero al PAOK, Gustavo giocava già nelle giovanili, nella formazione Under 17. A dire la verità, non seguivo molto le partite dell'Under 17, ma mi parlavano già molto bene di lui. Mi dicevano che aveva un grande fiuto del gol, che aveva proprio il senso del gol. E in effetti sta dimostrando tutto il suo valore. Sono convinto che diventerà un attaccante di livello mondiale".

L’opera zione di FI (e Lotito) per blindare Dazn al 2031

📅 27 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (461 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Laziopress

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • L’emendamento di Pella richiede una valutazione motivata della convenienza dell’accordo rispetto a una nuova gara.
  • Sources indicate that un emendamento alla manovra propone di prorogare di due anni, fino al 2031, l’attuale contratto dei diritti tv della Serie A, in scadenza nel 2029.
  • CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

L’emendamento di Pella richiede una valutazione motivata della convenienza dell’accordo rispetto a una nuova gara.

Sources indicate that un emendamento alla manovra propone di prorogare di due anni, fino al 2031, l’attuale contratto dei diritti tv della Serie A, in scadenza nel 2029. Secondo quanto riportato da Il Fatto Quotidiano, La proposta è firmata da Roberto Pella, esponente di Forza Italia e collega di partito di Claudio Lotito, senatore e presidente della Lazio. L’emendamento figura tra i 700 emendamenti «s e gn a l ati » alla manovra in Parlamento, .

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sources indicate that la proposta porta in Parlamento l’ipotesi di mantenere più a lungo gli accordi attuali con gli operatori. Arriva dopo mesi di contatti condotti sotto traccia, con l’idea di tentare un intervento parlamentare.

Recent findings suggest that I diritti tv valgono poco meno di un miliardo di euro e sostengono il calcio italiano. Dal 2021 la quota maggiore, circa 700 milioni di euro, è garantita da Dazn, mentre Sky ha un ruolo secondario. La scadenza del contratto nel 2029 preoccupa i presidenti dei club: il mercato dei campionati nazionali è in flessione a livello mondiale, anche per la concorrenza della Champions League, ed è debole in Italia.

In assenza di concorrenza, le offerte tendono a diminuire. Secondo la ricostruzione, i presidenti temono un forte calo degli introiti anche perché ritengono che il prodotto non valga la spesa richiesta agli operatori.

La Lega Serie A si è già mossa in vista della scadenza. L’Antitrust ha approvato le linee guida e il bando per il periodo 2029-2034 è atteso a inizio anno. L’amministratore delegato Luigi De Siervo, indicato come vicino alla conclusione del proprio percorso, è riuscito in passato a trovare soluzioni per i diritti tv: la prossima assegnazione resta il passaggio da affrontare.

Un’alternativa alla vendita dei diritti è il canale della Serie A, progetto per il quale la Lega si sta strutturando come media manufacturer. L’esperienza francese, descritta come fallimentare, e le difficoltà della stessa Dazn mostrano però quanto sia complicato ottenere dagli abbonamenti le risorse necessarie a far quadrare i conti.

La proroga rappresenterebbe una terza strada: mantenere per altri due anni gli accordi alle stesse cifre sarebbe vantaggioso per la Serie A. Per i broadcaster, in teoria, potrebbe esserci maggiore interesse a partecipare a una nuova gara. Dazn, tuttavia, punta alla quotazione in Borsa e ha interesse ad arrivarci con contratti importanti, come quello della Serie A, senza affrontare l’incertezza del bando. Sky, dal canto suo, ha trovato un proprio equilibrio.

Quanto ai tifosi, la ricostruzione attribuisce a una parte di loro una forte ostilità verso Dazn, giudicata in parte immotivata. Ricorda però anche i disservizi iniziali e le oscillazioni delle tariffe della piattaforma.

Antonio Cassano, opinionista, si è così espresso a Viva el Futbol commentando le opzioni in attacco per il calciomercato del Milan: "Da quello che stiamo vedendo, il lavoro dell'allenatore è fantastico: l'allenatore è forte, come parla, come allena, come fa rendere la squadra, niente da dire. Lui vuole giocare con un attaccante e due mezze punte".

Cassano si è soffermato sul duello per l'attacco del Milan tra Endrick e Tresoldi: "A me piace da impazzire Tresoldi, mi piace da impazzire Tresoldi, però significa che in quel caso là devi cambiare, devi cambiare ovviamente il tipo di modo di giocare. Se vai a prendere un centravanti è perché vuoi sostituire Gonçalo Ramos, che per me è un campionissimo: per me Gonçalo Ramos gioca, punto. Poi, se devi andare a prendere un altro tipo di giocatore, già Endrick è un giocatore che da centro-destra può giocare. Da centro-destra può giocare, Endrick andrebbe bene.

Industry observers note that però, in questo momento qua non lo so: io andrei a prendere più un difensore di un certo livello e un esterno, soprattutto a sinistra, anche se Musah sta facendo molto bene. In questo momento qua devi buttare un paio di pezzi per volta. In questo momento qua, se devo andare a prendere un attaccante, o vado a prendere Tresoldi, però cambio il modo di giocare. Però Tresoldi, da quello che dicono, devi andare sui sessanta-settanta milioni. Questo, ti ripeto, non lo so: o vai a prendere Endrick, che può fare il centro-destra, oppure vuoi andare eventualmente a prendere un altro centro-sinistra con Pulisic centro-destra, dove a Dortmund giocava, però Rabiot non lo puoi più sfruttare, come diceva Amorim, da, tra virgolette, finta mezza punta, chiamiamolo come vogliamo, e lo abbassi con Modric. Altrimenti devi continuare così.”.

Mauricio Pochettino blames Man United's 'painful' thrashing at Liverpool on 'unfair' red card - after Roy Keane lashes out at Gary Neville for suggesting 4-0 defeat was an 'OK result' with 10 men

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (926 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER and LEWIS BROWNING, SPORTS REPORTER.
  • Published: 16:32 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.
  • Mauricio Pochettino suggested the Leny Yoro red card that had such an affect ontheir defeat by Liverpool game was 'unfair' and that their opponents should have been 'punished' too.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER and LEWIS BROWNING, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 16:32 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino suggested the Leny Yoro red card that had such an affect ontheir defeat by Liverpool game was 'unfair' and that their opponents should have been 'punished' too.

Pochettino gave up his job as US national team coach to join United on Wednesday, but any hope of a new manager 'bounce' evaporated after Yoro was sent off inside eight minutes and his team were thrashed 4-0.

It was the joint-heaviest defeat for a fresh United manager since Lal Hilditch a century ago, and leaves Pochettino's side second from bottom of the Premier League.

Industry observers note that 'So painful, so disappointed,' mentioned the Argentine, who blamed the early red card for United's defeat. 'It's not OK to start a game in the Premier League with this situation. The game changed completely after eight minutes. Now we can explain everything, but the damage is done – it's so painful.

In a recent development, 'It's clear that after eight minutes the proposal was in the bin. Do you think that is easy? Even the best team in the world playing in this situation concedes four goals or maybe more.

It has been revealed that 'We are not going to lose more than one game how we lost today. I take the responsibility, and we keep pushing.

Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino blamed Leny Yoro's red card for his side's defeat by Liverpool.

Yoro (right) was sent off for fouling Alexander Isak inside eight minutes of Sunday's game.

'We feel pain for this defeat, but we need to keep our heads up and translate that anger into energy to start to work from tomorrow for the next game.

Sources indicate that 'We are in a situation that this is very complicated. It's difficult, yes, but I think we fight, we made the effort, and I know how they feel now in the dressing-room.

In a recent development, 'The players are feeling the pain of the result. I told them to be calm: it was an unfair situation that happened. We need to accept that reality. We need to try to increase our focus, concentration and make better decisions on the field.

'We also need to be critical on ourselves but some situations happened in the game that we are not happy.'.

Pochettino was unhappy that referee Sam Barrott highlighted Yoro a straight red card for his challenge on Alexander Isak, having taken no action over a similar incident involving Jeremy Jacquet and Bryan Mbeumo in the Liverpool penalty box moments earlier.

It has been revealed that 'In Leny's case, it wasn't intentional. It was an unusual situation that is normal. Everyone who plays football can feel it,' added the United boss. 'If you review the VAR you can see for sure, he never had the intention to connect with Isak. The ball was going to the goalkeeper.

Industry observers note that 'If you look before, in the sixth minute, Jacquet on Mbeumo. If you compare the actions, that was a penalty. We were punished badly and they were not punished, that is the truth.'.

He later added: 'One centre-back made a mistake and wasn't punished and us, we made one mistake and we were punished.'.

Kobbie Mainoo and Bruno Fernandes agreed their team-mate should not have been sent off.

United midfielder Kobbie Mainoo agreed with Pochettino that it wasn't a red card.

'No chance,' mentioned Mainoo. 'The ball is already with the keeper, and they're both running full speed. What can he do?

'I feel like the game has been taken out of our hands early by a red card that I don't think can be a red card.

In a recent development, 'It's hard but no-one is going to save us. We have to come together and keep digging, keep fighting, and it will come round.'.

Captain Bruno Fernandes, meanwhile, added: 'I can understand the fall, but it's never a red card, and I think it's too many referees on the pitch and too many on VAR with a long time to see, do it in slow motion, and make a mistake like this which can change the game.'.

Gary Neville, who was left slapping himself in the face in shock live on Sky Sports, was pleased with damage control on, with United conceding four when it looked at one point that it would have been many more.

Former United captain Roy Keane, however, wasn't, and took aim at his ex-side's display.

'I thought United were desperate,' he stated. 'So bad. Neville's OK with 4-0? Are you telling me they could have done better? 4-0 is not too bad with 10 men? Has anyone ever got a result with 10 men? It can be done.

Roy Keane (pictured), meanwhile, questioned why Gary Neville was pleased with the scoreline.

According to recent reports, 'People who played for the club remarked 4-0 is not too bad? Wow. Fans are applauding. Applauding what? Performing rubbish?

In a recent development, 'Liverpool were excellent but how easy did United make it for them? This team two years ago finished 15th. The last year or two, we're talking. We're blaming the board, blaming ownership, blaming managers. When do the players take responsibility for some decision-making?

'Liverpool probably should have scored eight, probably eight or nine, unbelievable chances they had. And everyone's coming off the pitch saying four is not too bad? I feel like swearing.'.

#153166. Manchester United hounded off pitch by own fans

Manchester United hounded off pitch by own fans

📅 17 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4659 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • After a humiliating defeat by Grimsby Town in their previous League Cup campaign, Manchester United found a different way to exit the competition this time around.
  • For the first time in half a century, United lost a game at Old Trafford having led 2-0, highlighting the defensive problems Michael Carrick needs to solve after turning results around last season.
  • “What the f---ing hell was that?” shouted the home fans, in a chant that may have been aimed at the referee but equally applied to United’s players, who led through Shea Lacey and Mason Mount’s early goals.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

After a humiliating defeat by Grimsby Town in their previous League Cup campaign, Manchester United found a different way to exit the competition this time around. The jeers heard at the full-time whistle after throwing away a two-goal lead pointed to more worrying times a year on from Blundell Park.

For the first time in half a century, United lost a game at Old Trafford having led 2-0, highlighting the defensive problems Michael Carrick needs to solve after turning results around last season.

“What the f---ing hell was that?” shouted the home fans, in a chant that may have been aimed at the referee but equally applied to United’s players, who led through Shea Lacey and Mason Mount’s early goals.

Industry observers note that brighton cut through Carrick’s defence several times before staging their comeback with goals from Charalampos Kostoulas, Pascal Gross and Maxim De Cuyper. Carrick and his analysts will rewatch the footage of all three goals in horror at how they conceded.

In a recent development, kostoulas halves the deficit! 🔵Brighton score on the stroke of half-time. pic.twitter.com/bGjN1w6s6c.

“I totally understand the feelings of the supporters,” Carrick remarked. “We have to accept it. I totally accept it. It’s on me ultimately: as a team what we look like, how we play and what results you get. I take that. I’ll take the praise, I’ll take the criticism and the upset.”.

Erik ten Hag used the domestic cups to taste success while struggling in the Premier League, but one of those opportunities is now lost to Carrick, who must be careful not to spiral from a poor start to the campaign into crisis. Sunday’s trip to Fulham before the international break now feels like a major game for United and Carrick.

“We’ve gone out of the cup and the feeling around the place feels bigger than that,” Carrick noted. “I’ll be honest about that, that’s how it feels, but it doesn’t have to be like that. If we win football matches again, it can go in a different direction.

“We have a massive game on Sunday that we have to prepare for. We’re out of this competition and we have to go back to winning football matches.

It has been revealed that “It doesn’t feel good at the moment. It doesn’t feel good. We have to go back to winning football matches. We want to win and want to win quickly. The next game is Sunday. That’s all I’m thinking about right now.”.

Sources indicate that at the start of the evening it seemed that the tie would be remembered for Lacey scoring on his first start for United, the first teenager to do so since Marcus Rashford. In the week when JJ Gabriel, one of United’s great academy talents, asked to leave the club, a different United teenager was kissing the badge when he found the net.

SHEA LACEY ON HIS FIRST START!!! 🔴🌟What a hit from the 19-year-old to open the scoring for Man Utd! pic.twitter.com/Ex2ceXaUge.

Recent findings suggest that mason Mount DOUBLES Man Utd's lead! 🤩 pic.twitter.com/c83ggCb8Bf.

And after Mount’s strike it looked like United were cruising into the fourth round for their first knockout win in 19 months, since defeating Leicester City in the FA Cup last year. But Brighton’s way back into the game was to get Gross, 35, on the ball and the veteran German controlled the game.

Gross took his chance when United carelessly played the ball out of defence again, with Diogo Dalot’s clearance mishit. Luka Vuskovic’s header went straight into the United penalty area, with their centre-backs failing to react promptly enough.

Pascal Gross takes advantage of a gifted opportunity to level the score! 🔥 pic.twitter.com/Qu2E0B6060.

The turnaround was completed a few minutes later when De Cuyper found the net, finishing off a counter-attack in which Diego Gómez and Kostoulas raided the left flank of United before cutting the ball back.

Sources indicate that brighton have turned it around!!! 🔵A sensational comeback as Maxim De Cuyper makes it 3-2 at Old Trafford. pic.twitter.com/Bfcr4N7mTL.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Per l’ex compagno, i due tecnici hanno idee chiare; la Lazio attacca con molti uomini, mentre il Toro cerca stabilità.

Massimo Ambrosini presenta Torino-Lazio come la prima sfida in panchina tra i suoi ex compagni Ignazio Abate e Rino Gattuso. Secondo quanto riportato da La Stampa, La partita del 28 novembre 2026, allo stadio Grande Torino, mette di fronte i granata in cerca di rivincita e i biancocelesti, primi in classifica e ancora imbattuti.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sources indicate that ripensando al Milan dello scudetto 2010/11, Ambrosini racconta che si aspettava di vedere Gattuso allenatore, mentre Abate lo aveva sorpreso per la curiosità e l’applicazione mostrate nello studio del gioco: «Ero quasi sicuro che Rino sarebbe diventato un allenatore, Ignazio un po’ meno. È sempre stato un grande entusiasta e una persona positiva, ma non lo facevo così curioso e applicato dal punto di vista teorico». Di quella squadra sono diventati tecnici anche Nesta, Inzaghi, Seedorf, Oddo e Pirlo.

According to recent reports, commentatore di Dazn, che trasmetterà l’incontro, Ambrosini si aspetta una prova coraggiosa dal Torino. Giocando in casa, i granata possono cercare una svolta senza lasciarsi intimidire dalla capolista. La Lazio, invece, dovrebbe continuare ad attaccare con molti uomini, senza modificare la propria idea di gioco in base all’avversario.

Industry observers note that «Il Toro deve fare una partita coraggiosa perché gioca in casa e può dare una svolta, quindi mi aspetto una prova gagliarda da parte di una squadra che non si spaventerà di affrontare la capolista. La Lazio, invece, giocherà come sempre: vorrà fare la partita, attaccando con tanti uomini. Rino ha già fatto vedere che cambiano gli avversari, ma non la sua idea di calcio», dice Ambrosini.

Quanto a una possibile carriera personale in panchina, la risposta dell’ex centrocampista è netta e scherzosa: «No, non mi avranno mai (ride, ndr). Sto bene così».

Per Ambrosini, il primato della Lazio si lega alle capacità di Gattuso e al lavoro svolto su una base già solida. L’ex capitano rossonero ricorda il calcio espresso dalle squadre allenate da Rino al Milan e al Napoli, distinguendo da quelle esperienze la parentesi in Nazionale, che considera particolare anche per i giocatori a disposizione.

«Rino lo conosco bene e conosco la capacità che ha di far giocare le proprie squadre. Al di là della Nazionale, una parentesi molto particolare anche per gli uomini che aveva a disposizione, Milan e Napoli giocavano un bel calcio con lui. È la sua storia che lo racconta e se la gente ha la memoria corta... Poi da lì a pensare che una squadra nella situazione in cui era la Lazio, con tutto quello che gli gira intorno, potesse fare questo tipo di percorso... Non se lo aspettava neanche lui, ma è giusto che sia primo per quel che sta facendo in campo», osserva Ambrosini.

It has been revealed that alla base del rendimento biancoceleste indica l’empatia costruita dal tecnico e i principi di gioco: «C’era una base solida, ma l’empatia creata da Gattuso e i principi di gioco hanno fatto la differenza». Il lavoro sulla fiducia, secondo Ambrosini, ha inciso anche sulla crescita dei singoli.

«La testa è fondamentale, ma non basta. Gattuso ha saputo tirare fuori il meglio da Isaksen, Frattesi o Taylor perché ha dato le conoscenze giuste per farli sentire in fiducia: così riesci a sfruttare il potenziale tecnico e atletico di ognuno», spiega.

Luca Serafini, giornalista, si è così espresso nel corso del suo editoriale su MilaNews.it commentando Olympiacos-Milan: "Sembravamo diventati una squadra di Cipro, Malta, uno Slavia Praga qualsiasi. Molle, svagato, disordinato: il Milan europeo, anche nel primo tempo greco, era una fotocopia triste e blanda delle altre partite, non metteva insieme 2 azioni di fila. Se si esclude Salisburgo non credo arrivi a 10 tiri in porta in 4 partite. L’atavica incapacità di difendere con la linea schierata, sui corner e in generale sui cross, è confermata ad Atene così come tutte le altre certificazioni negative di una squadra che decisamente la coppa non la avverte, non la sente, non la vive. A tutti i livelli.

Nel primo tempo ci prova solo Cisse un paio di volte: a parte Gila, nemmeno i migliori hanno granché voglia. Fantasmi che vagano nel prato a cogliere margherite. Ci si mette anche Maignan sul gol di Pirola, inchiodato sulla linea di porta. L’Olympiacos (come il Benfica, il Bournemouth, il Ferencvaros) pressa, palleggia e affonda a piacimento. In mezzo a statuine senza nerbo. Contro il Milan sembrano tutti giganti. La ripresa, senza Ramos ed Estupinian, inizia come era finita la prima parte: immediatamente il 2-0 e buonanotte.

Ma… Ma Hutchinson, schierato per 45’ quasi a fianco di Ramos, torna sulla sua fascia destra (Moreira torna a sinistra) e diventa l’incontenibile mattatore della notte al Pireo. Prima la bellissima azione solitaria e palla nell’angolino basso, 2-1. Poi ancora l’inglesino che col suo sinistro pennella sulla testa di Cisse, in mezzo alla stordita difesa greca (decimo gol per lui in questa stagione). Infine, la palla per la splendida girata di Pulisic: 2-3 spettacolare. Bastava non giocare, ma giochicchiare, e qualcosa si riesce a vedere. L’identità non si compra al mercato, ma il carattere bisogna forgiarlo. Amorim ci ha messo del suo perché, considerate le molte assenze, bisognava almeno non mischiare le carte. Rimesse a posto le idee, qualcosa è cambiato. Nel finale persino il lusso di divorarsi un contropiede 4 contro uno, ma al 94’ grande ribaltone e 2-4 di Moreira".

Latest Update: Gary Neville tears into Man United's Matthijs de Ligt for 'unforgivable' defending that led to Leny Yoro's red card - and claims duo played like 'they have never had basic defensive training'

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (776 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 12:23 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.
  • Gary Neville led the criticism of Manchester United's defending in the opening minutes against Liverpool as Mauricio Pochettino's reign started in disastrous fashion at Anfield.
  • After just eight minutes, his aims were thrown into tatters when errors from Matthijs de Ligt and Leny Yoro saw the latter sent off before Liverpool took a swift lead.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By LEWIS BROWNING, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 12:23 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.

Gary Neville led the criticism of Manchester United's defending in the opening minutes against Liverpool as Mauricio Pochettino's reign started in disastrous fashion at Anfield.

After just eight minutes, his aims were thrown into tatters when errors from Matthijs de Ligt and Leny Yoro saw the latter sent off before Liverpool took a swift lead.

A long ball from Ronald Araujo should have been dealt with easily by De Ligt, but the Dutchman found himself in no man's land, left the ball, and Alexander Isak raced clear.

That left Yoro scrambling to try to recover the situation for his side, but Isak stepped across him and he ended up fouling the Reds forward.

Referee Sam Barrott wasted no time in pulling out the red card, and United found themselves reduced to 10 men just minutes into a vital clash.

And former United defender Neville didn't hold back when it came to his analysis as he tore into the two players at fault.

In a recent development, leny Yoro is SENT OFF after eight minutes! 😱 pic.twitter.com/VKYvckvBBP.

Gary Neville torn into Manchester United duo Leny Yoro (right) and Matthijs de Ligt after the former was sent off.

Neville (pictured) questioned why the duo were playing as if they had 'never had basic training of how to play in defence'.

'When I saw De Ligt's name on the team sheet I have to admit I was absolutely stunned,' he stated, speaking on Sky Sports. 'And the reason I was stunned was because of this. If you'd watched him in Como four weeks ago he was very much well off it and that is just a basic ball over the top.

Industry observers note that 'It's his problem to start with, Yoro can be further across, but De Ligt is miles away from it, then Yoro has to get further round, he reacts late, his anticipation is poor. It's so clumsy from Yoro, he makes a lot of these types of mistakes.

'You could argue Isak delays to make sure Yoro runs into him, but it's naivety.'.

Pochettino was left scrambling to think of ideas to tighten up the defence but, before he could bring Harry Maguire on, it was 2-0 through Florian Wirtz.

Maguire eventually came on but it felt like too little, too late.

'We saw him in Como and he has been out for a year,' Neville continued on De Ligt. 'It is really tough to come back. To have him out there in a game like this, he has been exposed. Yoro's positioning is poor, he has to be across, you have to cover your mate. It is bad all around from United.

'Michael Carrick will be watching and say that's what I was having to deal with.'.

And his criticism didn't stop there. After having the chance to re-watch the incident, Neville's criticism grew even stronger.

De Ligt (left) failed to deal with a long ball as Alexander Isak (right) raced away before the foul.

Former United captain Roy Keane (pictured) added that he was 'amazed' by the errors made.

According to recent reports, 'It's as bad defending from two centre backs defending a long ball as you will see,' the former defender, who likened a return from a year out to playing after six pints of alcohol, added. 'De Ligt is well out of it - he's been out so I have some sympathy. But between them, to let the ball beat you, it's unforgivable.

Industry observers note that 'It is shocking. Whilst Man United have those types of defenders in their team, they have no chance of keeping a clean sheet.

'It's basic understanding of how to play a position. It's the fundamentals. It's like these guys have never had basic training of how to play in defence.'.

Former United captain Roy Keane chimed in too, adding at half-time: 'It doesn't matter if it's a back four or back five, you do the basics right.

'I'm amazed at this level, I know he's been out a while, but it's really poor defending. He's never getting that ball.

It has been revealed that 'If you're a defender you always expect the worst. Isak's done well and I actually don't think he's going to get the ball.

'There's no way he's (Yoro) getting the ball, it's clumsy by United. Straight ball over the top and he's in massive trouble. But there's no way he's getting that ball. I know he's quick and sharp but it's really poor defending. Players not smelling danger.'.

Enzo Maresca, allenatore del Manchester City, ha rilasciato alcune dichiarazioni in conferenza stampa dopo il pareggio in Champions League contro il Napoli.:  “Noi cerchiamo sempre di vincere, ma se non puoi vincere è importante non perdere. Prendiamo il punto, ne abbiamo 10 in classifica e in fin dei conti è un buon risultato per andare avanti. Ricordo un loro calcio d’angolo e i due gol, in questo momento gli avversari sono cinici davanti alla porta. C’è poco da fare, accettiamo il punto e andiamo avanti. L’impatto sui giocatori? In questo momento va un po’ così, le prime dieci partite siamo stati sempre noi a sbloccare, mentre ora sono gli avversari a farlo. Non credo che abbia un impatto sulla fiducia dei calciatori, devi correre un po’ di più se sei in svantaggio, ma abbiamo lottato fino alla fine e serve alzare l’asticella. Non dobbiamo subire questi gol, basta vedere le statistiche a nostro favore. C’è uno squilibrio tra le occasioni create e i gol segnati. Anche Cherki ha detto che mancava energia? Siamo stati molto aggressivi. I due terzini in posizione centrale? Abbiamo iniziato con Bouaddi e Enzo in mezzo per vedere se potevamo trovare equilibrio, poi Nico e Matheus Nunes hanno fatto bene, è un’altra opzione per noi. Volevamo fare qualche cambio ed essere più fisici in mezzo al campo per contrastarli. La qualità del gol di Cherki? Ottimo, sono contento per lui. Ha fatto bene, sappiamo che sa giocare meglio centralmente, ma sta facendo bene. Ci aspettavamo un Napoli col blocco basso, era difficile trovare soluzioni, ma dovevamo evitare di concedere i gol concessi, erano evitabili. I cori a Donnarumma? Non ci ho fatto caso, ero concentrato sulla partita. Era difficile attaccare il Napoli, erano in undici sulla linea dell’area. Potevamo fare meglio nelle chance avute e cercare di evitare le due occasioni concesse. Hanno avuto quelle e il corner di Beukema, c’è rammarico per non aver vinto, ma se non puoi farlo è importante anche non perdere. Non vinciamo da tre partite, ma i meriti del Napoli sono importanti: si è difeso bene e ha concretizzato due occasioni. Noi potevamo fare meglio, il Napoli ha avuto i suoi meriti e ha fatto una buona gara”.

#153158. Industry News: De Rossi: "Contro l'Inter serve la partita perfetta, anche loro prendono gol. Ostigard out"

Industry News: De Rossi: "Contro l'Inter serve la partita perfetta, anche loro prendono gol. Ostigard out"

📅 27 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (959 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Fcinter1908

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Scegli FcInter1908 come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.
  • Daniele De Rossi, tecnico del Genoa, ha presentato in conferenza stampa la sfida in programma domani contro l'Inter di Chivu: "A livello fisico la squadra sta bene.
  • Come si affronta una squadra come l'Inter che è passata dal 4-4 con l'Atalanta al successo in Champions League?
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Scegli FcInter1908 come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

Daniele De Rossi, tecnico del Genoa, ha presentato in conferenza stampa la sfida in programma domani contro l'Inter di Chivu: "A livello fisico la squadra sta bene. C'è qualche acciacco ovviamente, come hanno tutte le altre squadre. C’è qualche giocatore da valutare, ma potrebbe essere fuori almeno per questa partita, ma niente di preoccupante. Leo non verrà con noi a Milano, non è in condizioni per giocare questa partita, poi vedremo quella di martedì e col Torino per capire anche come recupera da questa sindrome influenzale".

Come si affronta una squadra come l'Inter che è passata dal 4-4 con l'Atalanta al successo in Champions League?

According to recent reports, "A prescindere dai risultati, è una squadra con valori incredibili e di grande continuità. Quest'anno ha avuto una nuova forma di spaventare tutti: ha fatto delle partite in cui magari non è partita benissimo e ha dimostrato la sua forza proprio in quelle partite. Li vedi che quando vogliono danno un po' di gas e fanno 2-3 gol a tutti. Noi dovremo essere bravi a rimanere in partita, ad essere coraggiosi, a fargli male nelle situazioni che possono essere usate proprio per far loro gol. I gol li subiscono anche loro, se ne stanno suvendo un po' di più un motivo ci sarà. Noi dobbiamo essere bravi a fare la partita perfetta".

Quest'anno c'è un Osmajic in più.

"Il nostro attaccante sta facendo bene, ma tutta la squadra sta capendo come servirlo. Ci abbiamo messo poco a capire in che maniera poteva essere devastante. Lo hanno capito anche i nostri avversari e raddoppieranno magari su di lui. Noi dovremo essere bravi a non lasciargli il peso dell'attacco sulle sue spalle, ma così non è stato visto che sono andati in gol e al tiro altri giocatori. Quando dico la partita perfetta non solo in fase difensiva, ma anche in quella offensiva. Quello che abbiamo fatto col Sassuolo non basterà contro l'Inter, perderemo sicuramente se dovessimo giocare la stessa partita di domenica: il livello qualitativo dell'Inter è talmente superiore che quelle occasioni concesse possono essere letali e decisive per la sconfitta. Il Sassuolo ci ha fatto più paura del Milan, contro i rossoneri siamo stati bravi a subire e concedere poco e ad essere più pericolosi di loro. Col Sassuolo un po' meno, a volte siamo stati un pizzico fortunati e invece siamo stati molto bravi a sfruttare le nostre occasioni. Quando il pallone è arrivato lì, ho visto giocate decisive, ho visto passaggi decisivi al momento giusto, sfruttare l'errore dell'avversario. La grande squadra fa anche questo".

Follia pensare di giocare con due formazioni diverse fra campionato e Coppa Italia?

"Viviamo non alla giornata, considerando che ci sono due partite ravvicinate. Considerando che questa settimana siamo arrivati con qualche giocatore acciaccato, due ragionamenti li faremo ma sulla seconda partita. Oggi non leverò dei giocatori per farli giocare martedì, non l'ho mai fatto. Non li ho levati contro il Venezia e non li ho tolti contro la Juventus per farli giocare contro il Lecce che era uno scontro diretto. Prepariamo le partite per rispetto del Genoa e e dei genoani, cercando di vincerle tutte e ovviamente di non mandare i giocatori al macello. L'anno scorso è stato un discorso un po', quando in Coppa Italia ero palesemente alla partita dopo contro l'Udinese. Era uno scontro diretto, eravamo in un momento difficile e la situazione di classifica era ancora tremenda. Adesso è tutto diverso, motivo in più per andare a fare le cose fatte bene, ma senza snobbare il campionato perché la classifica non ce lo permette, perché siamo ambiziosi e perché domani sarà una partita importante come quella di martedì. Faremo una partita seria in tutte e due le competizioni".

L'anno scorso Messias ha detto che mancava fare prestazione contro le major. Quest'anno ci sono state.

"L'ambizione di fare prestazioni importanti contro squadre top credo che sia alla base di quello che chiedo negli ultimi giorni. Ma contro Juventus, Milan lo abbiamo fatto e siamo stati vicini alla perfezione. E contro la Roma, contro una squadra che in Italia e in Europa va e calpesta gli avversari, abbiamo fatto 50 minuti molto ordinati e subendo poco, poi abbiamo preso un gol abbastanza folle e unico e la partita è cambiata. Queste sono le partite che voglio vedere contro le grandi squadre, poi il risultato oscilla a seconda di una giornata poco felice di un giocatore nostro o loro. Ho visto una buona partita anche contro il Napoli e una buona partenza contro il Como. Queste sono le prestazioni e noi dobbiamo essere chiari e onesti nel dirci che stiamo crescendo ma, anche al nostro massimo, siamo lontani dal massimo dell'Inter. Dobbiamo fare la partita perfetta, sperando che l'Inter non sia proprio in una grande serata e che gli astri, grazie alla nostra partita perfetta, inclinino a favore nostro. L'Inter è una squadra veramente unica per numeri, ma anche visivamente si vede lontano un miglio che sono pericolosissimi quando attaccano. E poi vedremo in che condizioni troveremo l'Inter: se sarà al 100%, il nostro 100% forse non basterà".

Che differenza c'è fra l'Inter in Europa e in campionato?

"La differenza sono sottigliezze e sfumature che è meglio chiedere a Chivu. Abbiamo visto le partite con lo Stoccarda e con il Como, e ho visto una grande squadra. A Bergamo ho visto una grande squadra che la partita l'aveva ammazzata ma poi ha subito un paio di calci d'angolo che hanno rimesso tutto quanto in ballo. Ultimamente non riesco a vedere punti deboli all'Inter, se non il fatto che ogni tanto inciampi anche lei. #153157. Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

Floyd Samba’s Man City debut double has father Chris dancing

📅 17 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 21 min read (4102 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~21 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.
  • This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.
  • But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.

This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.

But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.

Floyd Samba scored two fine goals and had a hand in another on a dream debut that had his beaming dad up off his seat and thrusting his arms in the air as if ready to party.

If the Samba surname feels familiar, that is because Floyd’s father Christopher played more than 200 games for Blackburn Rovers, Queens Park Rangers and Aston Villa.

In fact, it was very much a family affair as Floyd’s brothers Tyrone and Emerson, who are also in City’s academy and hoping one day to tread a similar path, joined in the jubilant celebrations alongside their mother, a visibly emotional Theresa.

Sources indicate that this particular evening belonged to Floyd, though. Deployed as a lone striker by Enzo Maresca, you would not have known he ordinarily plays as a midfielder such was the confidence and composure the 17-year-old oozed.

Norwich could not live with him or City for that matter as Maresca’s impressive start as manager since replacing Pep Guardiola continued apace.

Sources indicate that this must have been an incredibly satisfying moment for Samba Sr. He came through incredible hardship – at one stage as a teenager he was rough-sleeping – to forge an impressive career totalling more than 450 games for club and country.

Sources indicate that so to be in a position to now have three sons in City’s academy and one produce a debut like this will fill him with enormous pride. Floyd was later seen enjoying a warm embrace with his dad in the crowd, moments after being congratulated by Tyrone, a year his senior, and 12-year-old Emerson, who plays for City’s Under-13s.

In a recent development, “I knew there would be an opportunity to get some minutes for the first time with the first team – to get a debut like that is mind blowing,” Samba said. “I couldn’t believe it myself, but that’s just the beginning, I’ve got a major career ahead of me. It was a great debut.”.

In a recent development, floyd caught the eye with a fine free-kick in City’s 2-1 FA Youth Cup final victory over Manchester United last season and now he has goals for the senior side to his name. Pretty stunning they were, too.

The first was a superbly steered header past two Norwich bodies on the line from Allan’s cross and the second a lovely, nonchalantly curled finish low into the far corner.

Recent findings suggest that what a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Industry observers note that chris Samba has deliberately kept a low profile, keen to let his sons get on with their own careers free of distractions, but there was no chance he was going to be able to suppress his emotions in that instant. And nor should he. It was some moment for the boy and his family.

In a recent development, as impressed as Maresca was by the goals, it will have been other elements of Samba’s game that also caught the eye. He did extremely well to hold off the attentions of Norwich’s centre-backs when receiving a pass from Ayyoub Bouaddi and then returning the ball to the Moroccan who released Rayan Cherki through to score City’s second. His movement was also sharp, at one point taking a difficult pass sweetly in an adjusted strike, only for Norwich’s Bruno Alves to come across to make a timely intervention before Samba could get his shot off.

"Was there any doubt?"Ayyoub Bouaddi with his first assist for Man City as he sets up Rayan Cherki to make it 2-0 🔵 pic.twitter.com/0gfxp5GDXy.

“It was satisfying not just for the two goals but for the entire performance,” Maresca remarked. “He didn’t play many games as a nine but he was good. He’s young, full of energy, strong, he can finish.”.

It has been revealed that allan, a £34m summer signing from Palmeiras, will have been just as pleased with his contribution. Maresca’s fluid formation initially resembled a 3-1-5-1 with Allan effectively operating as a right wing-back but he stuck doggedly to the task before eventually getting the moment to showcase his quality, first with his cross for Samba and later with a neat solo run and finish.

Driving inside Sam Field and then cutting back inside the Norwich man before curling an inch perfect finish into the bottom corner – all of it done with his left foot – it was quite the introduction.

Allan on his debut! 🇧🇷Magic from the Brazilian to make it 3-0 to Man City 💥 pic.twitter.com/nw6lNqh1yL.

Hugo Viana, City’s director of football, has said supporters will need to be patient with Allan and that it may take the 22-year-old time to adjust to English football but this first outing will do his confidence plenty of good.

“It was crucial for him to play 90 minutes and to see a little bit the English competition that is a bit different from South America so overall was good,” Maresca stated.

According to recent reports, cherki was the only survivor from the team that started Sunday’s victory over Manchester United but it all felt pretty seamless from City. Bouaddi, the £85m signing from Lille, was poised and graceful in midfield alongside the impressive Mateo Kovacic and Geronimo Rulli could not have asked for a much quieter debut in goal.

In a recent development, FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Nico O’Reilly looked like he had barely broken a sweat despite Norwich’s players routinely being unable to keep up with him. Norwich themselves made nine changes but the gulf in class was enormous and testament to City’s strength in depth.

The game also gave Maresca the opportunity to give run outs to two more academy graduates who played in that Youth Cup final triumph, Kaden Braithwaite and Ryan McAidoo and the latter got his own name on the scoresheet to make it 5-0.

All told there were seven City academy graduates on the pitch, two of them playing for Norwich. This was certainly a night to remember for the club’s youth production line.

With the dominant performance, Man City have earned themselves the privilege of hosting Brighton in the next round, who will no doubt prove a much stiffer challenge than Norwich. They become the sixth all-Premier League tie in the next round, with only Fleetwood, Bradford and Peterborough remaining from outside the top flight:.

Possession: Man City 66% vs 34% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 30 vs 4.

In a recent development, erling Haaland left out of the squad, watching from the stands, would have enjoyed that performance from Floyd Samba. Here is his second goal for you to enjoy on his debut night:.

Recent findings suggest that FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Five unanswered goals and a home-grown hero emerges for Manchester City!

Great through ball from O’Reilly, which Lewis lets run past him for the dummy. McAidoo runs on to it on the right of the box and first-time fires it low into the far corner.

It has been a perfect night for Manchester City’s academy.

Well we look like we’re heading for a matching scoreline to the previous edition of the fixture. That pesky shot on target is still eluding Norwich, whereas Samba is still out there looking for his hat-trick.

Two minutes of time to be added – who will get there first?

O’Reilly sends a high, looping ball to the back post from the left side, where McAidoo rushes to meet it but can’t get over it under pressure.

Final change for Norwich, as Kvistgaarden who has not had much service tonight, comes off for Schwartau.

Bouaddi sends a looping ball across the field to McAidoo, which he picks up on the edge of the box, but he is unable to get the ball under control to take his shot and it is cleared away as far as another City shirt.

The corner comes in to the centre of the box but is headed out by a City shirt.

It’s all slightly too little too late for Norwich.

They get another corner as Musaba tries to send a cross into the box from the right and it is blocked out.

Recent findings suggest that A free-kick for Norwich now as O’Reilly commits the foul 35 yards out. It goes in towards McConville at the back post, but Ait-Nouri heads it out for a Norwich corner.

Mo Touré strays just offside on the edge of the box, as Musaba sends a lovely little ball over to find him on the turn and the forward slots it past Rulli. Celebrations don’t quite begin before the flag goes up but that is a shame for the visitors.

Norwich have managed to get more of a grip in this half, despite conceding two more goals, but they are still without a shot on goal as we approach the final 15 minutes.

Another round of changes for both sides.

Man City take off scorer of their third goal Allan to bring on Braithwaite.

Norwich replace Ben Slimane and Bruno Alves with Touré and McConville.

Samba again at the heart of the action, laying off the ball to McAidoo on the right for the winger to run into the box. His shot towards the far post is saved low by Grimshaw who spills it almost into the path of Lewis, but Norwich survive.

Lewis makes a run down the right-hand side and crosses into Samba on the edge of the box. He lays off to McAidoo, but his shot goes sailing over the bar.

A surprise to no one, it is chucking it down in Manchester.

Significant cheers from the away end as Norwich get their first corner of the evening. It is lofted high and long to the back post, where it is headed away by Bouaddi. It bounces out to Musaba, who has just come on, and he strikes it from the top of the box on the half-volley.

According to recent reports, his shot cuts through a crowd in the box and has Rulli diving to his left, but it goes wide of the post. What an introduction that would have been!

In a recent development, well all the stories from this match will be all about young Floyd Samba. Feel free to leave your best punny Samba/dance-related headlines in the comments section.

For Man City as you would expect it is all about game management from here on out.

Some more changes to report for Norwich as well, as Crnac is replaced by Musaba.

Wright is able to run in to space towards the edge of the box, but as has been their story all evening, his pass out to the wing is just not where it needs to be and their effort just breaks down.

Sources indicate that what a way to score a second! A night to remember for Floyd Samba!

Recent findings suggest that norwich try and play out from the back but far too sloppy and Ait-Nouri picks up the ball on the left of the box. He has plenty of time to tee up Samba inside the box at the left corner, who finds himself with plenty of space to curl his shot into the far corner, beating the diving Grimshaw.

We may be seeing plenty more of him this season.

It has been revealed that norwich looking for their way back into the game, as the ball comes down the left, fizzed in low and flashes past Rulli, trying to claim it. It deflects off a crowd of bodies and spins up, but Fisher can’t connect and it spins away harmlessly wide of the goal.

It is definitely Norwich’s best chance of the game and Fisher will be upset he hasn’t made more of that.

In a recent development, and Allan makes it three! Minutes after the restart, the Brazilian makes his own mark on his debut.

In a recent development, maresca switched him onto the left side to escape Yongwa, and he picks up the ball outside the box and makes the run inside. He runs circles around Field and slots the ball home into the far bottom corner.

Some changes from both sides at half-time. McAidoo comes on for Cherki, though O’Reilly is the one to move up into midfield to fill the gap.

Norwich take off Diallo for Maghoma.

45 minutes left for the visitors to create something special!

What a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Manchester City will be the ones to host Brighton in the next round – giving the visitors the opportunity to pull off a remarkable feat of knocking out both Manchester sides should they win.

Enjoy the highlights from last night as they came from behind to dispatch Man Utd:.

Possession: Man City 72% vs 28% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 15 vs 1.

And without much ado at the end of the half, we have reached the break. City put themselves in control with two quick-fire goals and it looks a tall task for Norwich to find their way back into the match.

In a recent development, credit where it is due, Yongwa has been very good for Norwich. He has stood fast, made some very good challenges and stopped Allan getting much of a look-in on the right.

As we approach half-time, the stats tell a sorry story. Norwich have had just 28% possession and created a single shot, none on target.

As City come again, Norwich have pulled every man back to try and keep the situation salvageable before the break.

In a recent development, samba was in again there, making a run into the box with a ball from Cherki, wrestling with Bruno Alves as he goes. The defender does enough to throw him off and Grimshaw is able to come out and snatch the ball.

Man City are looking to close this out now, and they look threatening every time they break.

Ait-Nouri is the latest to try his luck, making a run into the box from the left, but his shot is blocked.

It has been revealed that A few minutes to remember here for Floyd Samba. First he steers home a very well taken header to give City the lead and then he plays a crucial role in the second, holding the ball up well before laying it off to Bouaddi to release Cherki to score. That’s how to make an impression on your debut.

And the floodgates have opened. Two goals in two minutes for the defending champions.

Samba finds Bouaddi in midfield, who takes it forward and feeds Cherki running to his left. He gets himself one-on-one and slots cool as you like into the bottom left corner.

City are in control all of a sudden and Norwich will be devastated.

As soon as I say that, Floyd Samba finds a way through.

Industry observers note that he has looked the brightest for City, and O’Reilly sends a cross over the box from the left, drawing Grimshaw away from position. The ball is pinged back in by Allan and the youngster stoops to meet it, heading in to the bottom corner.

Industry observers note that norwich have been very disciplined in defence so far. Yongwa has been closing down Allan on the wing very well.

Cherki is starting to get some momentum – but is swarmed by yellow shirts as he picks up the ball on the edge of the area.

Recent findings suggest that another loose ball from City in midfield and Norwich pick it up again. The ball to set the front line free is equally as loose from the visitors though and it breaks down once again.

According to recent reports, samba is looking lively, racing to get on a ball in front of Darling just on the edge of the box. Darling recovers to send it out for a corner, which becomes a free kick after Ait-Nouri wrestles his man to the ground at the back post as City are taking.

Wright sends a long ball across the field, looking for a man on the right side but Rulli is alert to it and comes to claim at the edge of the box.

Kovacic reveals some promise with a strong run on the ball down the centre of the field, taking the ball all the way to the edge of the box, where he collides with a defender, and the ball spins away for Norwich to clear out.

This is better from City, who have looked like they’re lacking drive so far.

It has been revealed that yongwa again probing down the left side. It takes two to dispossess him and Man City manage to get the throw in, but approaching 20 minutes Norwich will be happy with this.

Kovacic loses the ball in midfield and Norwich surge forward. The move breaks down as Wright’s pass to Diallo on the wing is just behind him and he can’t take it forward into the box.

Spent the first 10 minutes trying to work out City’s system and settled on a 3-1-5-1, with Bouaddi operating as a nominal third centre-back, but it seems to have changed again now with O’Reilly dropping to left back and Bouaddi stepping into midfield. No doubt the metamorphosis will continue.

This Man City team have never played all together and it is clear that they’re still settling in here, figuring out how they’re going to press here.

Kovacic in the captain’s armband is tying it all together in midfield.

Khusanov threads a lovely ball to Samba who flicks it into the path of Lewis, who takes it and makes a run into the box. He creates space and sends a right-footed shot over the bar – but Man City are building.

Norwich make a move forward, with Yongwa bringing the ball down the left side but his cross into the box is blocked by Allan sliding in. The Brazilian is then fouled again as Yongwa tries to reclaim the ball and Man City get back in possession.

Industry observers note that it’s actually three Samba brothers at City. The youngest, Emerson, is also in the academy.

Early foul on Allan gets Man City a free kick and they have started as everyone expected they would – in plenty of possession.

They look for the early goal as O’Reilly feeds him in the from the left side, but the shot is blocked.

We have kicked off in Manchester!

With just over 10 minutes until kick-off here are the teams for tonight’s fixture:.

Man City XI: Rulli; O’Reilly, Vitor Reis, Khusanov, Lewis; Kovacic (c), Bouaddi; Ait-Nouri, Cherki, Allan; Samba.

Subs: Anderson, Braithwaite, Donnarumma, Fernández, Guéhi, McAidoo, Ndiaye, Matheus Nunes, Semenyo.

Norwich City XI: Grimshaw; Yongwa, Bruno Alves, Darling (c), Fisher; Field, Wright; Diallo, Ben Slimane, Crnac; Kvistgaarden.

Subs: Chrisene, Mattsson, Kovacevic, Maghoma, McConville, Musaba, Schwartau, Stacey, Touré.

"It's part of the decision that I took when I decided to join this club"Enzo Maresca responds to the doubts surrounding him filling Pep Guardiola's shoes 👇 pic.twitter.com/o6eUjQUOnU.

David 🆚 Goliath 🤝🎥 https://t.co/5YXw2tQvfX pic.twitter.com/fTp9zD0xiX.

As Abdukodir Khusanov makes his fourth start of the season, Hugo Viana, Man City director of football, has been speaking about the young Uzbek. The 22-year-old signed a upcoming five-year contract with City in July, and Viana has affirmed that he “will be one of the best centre-backs in the world”.

"Abdukodir Khusanov will be one of the best centre-backs in the world" - Hugo Viana 🇺🇿🌏Full interview 🔗 https://t.co/dk3Qi8DF8D pic.twitter.com/hHdVdX5HSF.

It’s nine changes for Norwich from the squad that lost 4-3 to Middlesbrough on the weekend.

Norwich goalkeeper Daniel Grimshaw came through the ranks at Manchester City, joining as a teenager, so this will be a special night for the 28-year-old.

It has been revealed that speaking of Phil Foden, the winger will not be making an appearance tonight, as he is serving his three-match suspension following his sending off in the Manchester derby. The England international lashed out at Bruno Fernandes after the United captain had fouled him, resulting in a red card for violent conduct.

As well as this fixture, he will also be missing City’s game against Sunderland and the trip to Anfield to face Liverpool the following weekend.

We broke down the incident as it happened on Sunday and you can get the full story here.

Heavy squad rotation (10 changes in total for Maresca) has handed debuts for Gero Rulli in goal, as well as Allan and Floyd Samba in the outfield.

17-year-old Samba is the latest from City’s academy to be making his debut in the senior squad, following in the footsteps of Phil Foden, Rico Lewis, Nico O’Reilly and many more. A versatile midfielder, he has totalled 24 appearances across six competitions (incl Premier League 2) and scored 17 and assisted six goals in those matches.

Keep your eyes on young midfielder Floyd Samba, who has been handed his Manchester City debut tonight against Norwich by manager Enzo Maresca. Floyd is the 17 year old son of former Blackburn Rovers defender Christopher Samba.

His older brother Tyrone, 18, also plays for City. The siblings played in City’s FA Youth Cup final win over Manchester United last season, with Floyd scoring the first in a 2-1 win.

It has been revealed that city fans will also be keen to see how Allan Elias gets on on his first start, having arrived from Palmeiras for £34m. Geronimo Rulli also debuts in goal.

Checking in 🚌🚶‍♂️ pic.twitter.com/xWYGyaH7TY.

Manchester City or Norwich vs Brighton.

Ⓒ Darling with the armband🧤 Grimshaw in goal⚡️ Ante on the rightYour Yellows for this evening ⬇️ pic.twitter.com/znOGtvyJyk.

According to recent reports, good evening and welcome to another night of Carabao Cup coverage! It is the final fixture of round three (I promise) as Manchester City host Norwich.

These two sides have not met since 2022, when Norwich were still in the top flight and were beaten 4-0 by City. Looking at their previous meetings, the odds are definitely stacked in favour of Enzo Maresca’s side, who have scored 14 unanswered goals in their last three meetings with Norwich, while the Championship side have not scored any.

City will be looking to make it six straight wins across all competitions tonight, having started perfectly in the Premier League with four wins from four, and comfortably seeing off Porto in their Champions League opener.

They were the talk of the weekend with their deeply controversial 1-0 win over rivals Manchester United as – having gone down to 10 men after Phil Foden was sent off – their winning goal was allowed to stand despite Enzo Fernández being clearly in an offside position that impacted United’s keeper and backline.

Erling Haaland has put Manchester City ahead in the derby after a VAR check ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/V0DCwryhFy.

City are defending their title in this competition – beating Arsenal last year in the final – but like all Premier League teams playing in European competitions, have only entered the tournament this year in the third round.

Recent findings suggest that philippe Clement’s side beat MK Dons 4-1 in the first round, and followed that up with a 2-1 win over Cardiff City in the second to reach the Etihad tonight. The fourth-round draw has already been done, and it has been decided that the winner of this match will face Brighton.

But we have at least 90 minutes of the third round left before that, so without further ado, we’ll get underway and bring you team updates shortly!

Fabrizio Romano: "Su Bruno Fernandes bisogna distinguere tra rinnovo e prolungamento. Il Milan lo terrei sempre attento a quello che succede"

📅 27 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (514 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Milannews

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Nella giornata odierna il Manchester United ha comunicato di aver attivato l'opzione unilaterale per il prolungamento annuale dell'attuale accordo di Bruno Fernandes con i Red Devils.
  • Recent findings suggest that “Su Bruno Fernandes abbiamo raccontato questo retroscena legato alla scorsa estate.
  • Non ha mai rinnovato il contratto e oggi ho visto tanti dire “Addio Italia”.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Nella giornata odierna il Manchester United ha comunicato di aver attivato l'opzione unilaterale per il prolungamento annuale dell'attuale accordo di Bruno Fernandes con i Red Devils. Questo vuol dire che il portoghese non potrà più arrivare a parametro zero a giugno 2027, ma il suo futuro è comunque tutt'altro che legato in modo definitivo al Manchester. Fabrizio Romano, in un video sul suo canale YouTube, fa il punto della situazione.

Recent findings suggest that “Su Bruno Fernandes abbiamo raccontato questo retroscena legato alla scorsa estate. Prima ci ha provato la Juve, poi ci ha provato il con forza il Milan. Il giocatore ha scelto di rimanere a Manchester ma non ha mai rinnovato il suo contratto durante l’estate. Aveva offerte importanti, non solo dall’Italia. Il Galatasaray avrebbe offerto tanti soldi, un anno fa l’Al Hilas - a giugno 2025 - avrebbe messo sul tavolo cifre folli. Aveva tante possibilità diverse, dal punto di vista, competitivo ed economico, ma ha scelto di rimanere allo United.

Non ha mai rinnovato il contratto e oggi ho visto tanti dire “Addio Italia”. Io credo che il rinnovo di oggi sia più una protezione dell’asset Bruno Fernandes da parte del Manchester, piuttosto che una buona notizia per tenere il giocatore più a lungo. Club e giocatore da mesi stavano parlando, e hanno parlato, di rinnovo di contratto. Ma rinnovo vuol dire una cosa, estensione un’altra. “Contract extended” vuol dire che l’attuale contratto viene prolungato per un altro anno, com’è stato per Bruno Fernandes. “Fresh deal” invece vuol dire farne uno completamente diverso. È questa la differenza.

Oggi lo United attiva la clausola per un altro anno, che consente di proteggere Bruno Fernandes come cartellino, in modo che il calciatore non possa firmare a zero con un’altra squadra a gennaio. Lo United ha avuto il bisogno di fare ciò perché il nuovo contratto di Bruno Fernandes è tutto meno che vicino. Oggi le conversazioni sono ferme: il giocatore ha messo tutto in standby per una ragione. Vuole sapere che United sarà. Bruno vuole tempo per decidere, capire come andrà con Pochettino e che progetto ci sarà. Questo rinnovo protegge lo United da un punto di vista finanziario.

Ma c’è una clausola rescissoria - 65 milioni - nel contratto di Bruno Fernandes. Ma per età e durata di contratto credo che un eventuale prezzo sarebbe comunque più basso. Bruno Fernandes, per il rapporto che ha con lo United, se dovesse decidere di andare via a fine stagione, questo contratto protegge lo United dal perderlo a zero ma non bloccherebbe l’uscita del giocatore. È tutt’altro che deciso il futuro del portoghese. Cambiano le dinamiche economiche del mercato ma non che Bruno Fernandes a oggi non ha deciso. Se poi rinnoverà, sarà un contratto completamente nuovo. Aggiungo sempre il rapporto con Amorim, ci tengo sempre a ricordarlo. Amorim e Bruno hanno un grande rapporto, hanno lo stesso agente. C’è una stima enorme tra i due: il Milan lo terrei sempre attento a quello che succede. Ma poi è chiaro che non dipende dal Milan quello che succede. Dunque, vedremo”.

  • Sources indicate that what can he do to improve this shambles of a team?
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 02:00 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 10:28 EST, 24 November 2026.

As the fourth goal flew in and Anfield rejoiced once again, Mauricio Pochettino stood on the touchline with his arms folded and turned to the Manchester United bench with an air of resignation.

Sources indicate that what can he do to improve this shambles of a team? What could anyone do? United could change their head coach every game, but without the tools to do the job, the result will be largely the same.

In a recent development, chief executive Omar Berrada noted in an interview during the week that United have improved since the summer, but who is he trying to kid? They are in the relegation zone on merit, and it will need all of Pochettino's coaching powers to get them out of it.

He emerged from the tunnel shortly before 4.30pm here dressed smartly in blue, and after greeting Andoni Iraola and his staff, spent a few moments gathering his thoughts while You'll Never Walk Alone echoed around Anfield.

The game plan was in tatters inside 13 minutes, though, as he watched United go two goals and one man down. There was much finger wagging from Pochettino when Leny Yoro was somewhat harshly sent off, but the decision was never going to be overturned and nor should it be used to mask another United debacle.

As the enormity of the task he has taken on dawned upon him in the second half, the Liverpool fans taunted: 'Poch is the wheel.'.

Mauricio Pochettino's first game as Man United head coach ended in a 4-0 defeat at Liverpool.

The manner of the display was a microcosm of why United are mired in the relegation zone.

Pochettino made two changes to the line-up from Michael Carrick's last game in charge against Aston Villa, and the biggest of them backfired spectacularly.

Giving Matthijs de Ligt his Premier League start for more than a year against Liverpool at Anfield felt like a gamble as he replaced Harry Maguire in central defence.

'When I saw Matthijs de Ligt's name on the team-sheet I was absolutely stunned,' admitted former United defender Gary Neville on Sky Sports, citing De Ligt's performance on his only start since last November in the Champions League defeat by Como in October.

However, the Dutchman was at fault for misreading the situation that led to Yoro being sent off in the eighth minute for the foul on Alexander Isak that saw Dominik Szoboszlai fire Liverpool ahead from a free-kick, and was the nearest United defender to Florian Wirtz when he hooked in the second shortly afterwards.

De Ligt got away with falling flat on his face and allowing Isak a free run on goal just after the hour mark, but couldn't stop Bradley Barcola's cross going through his legs when Rio Ngumoha scored the third shortly afterwards.

The nightmare was complete when his ill-judged pass to Joshua Zirkzee let in Liverpool for Victor Munoz to make it 4-0.

Pochettino's other change was to leave out Amad Diallo - who has claimed a couple of memorable goals against Liverpool but hasn't scored for United in nearly a year - and play Patrick Dorgu on the left.

Dorgu returned from injury to head a dramatic late equaliser in Carrick's final game in charge, but he was deemed to be unfit for duty by Denmark who sent him home during the international break.

He started on the left side of attack but switched to left-back when Yoro was sent off and Pochettino reshuffled what is statistically the worst defence in Europe as he tried to avoid a bloodbath.

Matthijs de Ligt (right) endured a nightmare game at centre-back as United were thumped.

Pochettino's response to a horror start was to send on Maguire for Bryan Mbeumo, his best attacker, to provide extra protection for De Ligt.

Having started the game in United's familiar 4-2-3-1 formation, he switched to 5-3-1. Moving to a back-five when your team only has 10 men felt like damage limitation.

It needed some excellent saves from Senne Lammens - not to mention a crucial block by Maguire to send Isak's effort over the bar before half-time - to spare United from an embarrassing defeat on a par with the seven and five goal humiliations at the hands of Liverpool in recent years.

Even so, after seeing his team record a pitiful xG of 0.14 in a first half that saw United have one shot on target and four touches in the Liverpool box, he knew they had to pose more of an attacking threat if only to relieve the pressure on their defence.

Zirkzee replaced the anonymous Matheus Cunha at half-time in the hope that he could hold the ball up better, but the xG rose only marginally to 0.63 by the end compared to Liverpool's 4.38.

Pochettino sent on Mason Mount and Noussair Mazraoui for Youri Tielemans and Dorgu in the 65th minute, and they had only been on the pitch for a matter of seconds when Ngumoha got Liverpool's third.

Senne Lammens produced multiple save to prevent the scoreline from further embarrasment.

There are so many problems piled up for Pochettino, it will be difficult to know where to start when he returns to his desk at Carrington on Monday ahead of this week's Champions League tie against Sporting Lisbon in Portugal.

This is a team chronically short of form and confidence that has forgotten how to win. There are only so many changes he can make with the squad available until the January transfer window, so the Argentine is stuck with what he's got until then.

According to recent reports, but United have simply got to stop giving up early goals. It was a problem that plagued Carrick against Atletico Madrid, Como, Roma and Villa, and any hope that Pochettino could stop the rot disappeared inside eight minutes here.

Yoro's red card was also United's fourth in the last eight games (and his second), which is another bad habit they will have to kick if Pochettino is going to turn this season from hell around.
